reviews.text:
Thank you for the 5-star review! It was great seeing Daisy, and we appreciate you trusting our team with her care. We’re grateful to be part of her veterinary care and hope she’s doing well!
Courtney, Hospital Director
The staff is friendly and takes the time to talk to you about your concerns.
They take care of your pets very well here, I have brought my car here a few times and the team is very professional and nice.
Always nice, friendly and extremely helpful.
What a joke.

I wanted to thank Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital
Our beloved Vladimir has sadly crossed over the rainbow bridge

But your team did so much to make him as comfortable as we could during his hardest weeks

We came from another Vet because we needed additional support we weren’t getting and Vladimir was struggling so much.

Even if for just that short time
Dobbins Village Vet did so much for us and Vladimir♥️

Our family is so absolutely grateful for your team
Your passion for care, compassion and empathy in such a difficult moment meant so much to our family

We love your team

Also our Londyn says hello and that she will see you for her follow up in 2 months lol
Well treated, clean offices, caring staff, well organized.
Thank you for the 5-star review! We loved caring for Cody for his neuter and appreciate you trusting our Laveen veterinary team with his care. We look forward to seeing Cody again!

The staff here are really friendly, and the Dr.O  is super nice and welcoming. She’s always so kind and gentle with my dogs, and she takes great care of them. She always keeps me informed and makes sure I understand what I need to do to take care of my dogs properly. She’s very kind, professional, and truly cares about her patients. I’m really happy with the care they receive here! 😁
It really shows how much the staff cares here.

We were very impressed with our experience. The entire staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and Dr. Ou was professional, knowledgeable, and extremely helpful.

She took the time to listen to our concerns, answer all of our questions, and thoroughly address the issues we discussed. We never felt rushed, and we really appreciated the time and care she gave us.

Overall, it was a very positive experience, and we would definitely recommend Dr. Ou and the entire team.
customer service is absolutely amazing and they truly cared! my kitty had 7 teeth removed and she’s doing amazing:) i definitely recommend!!

A couple months ago our cat got very ill and Dr. Ou saw us here as an emergency since we couldn’t get into our regular vet. The whole experience was as smooth as can be. We felt comfortable, they explained everything and were very compassionate. They treated cowboy(our cat) with such gentleness. Needless to say, Dr.Ou will be our new vet! Very highly recommend this vet clinic.
My Maltese was seen at seen at Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital twice, and our experience both times were exceptional. I highly recommend!

Dobbins is under new ownership and this place has changed! Dr. O is absolutely wonderful.  She knows what needs to happen and doesn’t give you 10 different options on what you can do.  She is very precise and super knowledgeable. Their prices are very reasonable.

Thank you for the fantastic rating, Erica! We're dedicated to providing excellent service and appreciate your support. Looking forward to continuing to meet your expectations! Angel Bobadilla, Hospital Director.

Thank you for the five-star rating, Jesse! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us. Your satisfaction means a lot to our team! Angel Bobadilla, Hospital Director.
We had a great experience at Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital for a new client exam. The staff was friendly and helpful.
Thank you for your wonderful service. Coco is back to being himself.

Everyone is very kind and very attentive. They take the time to explain procedures, testing and pricing and it was very appreciated. They were very sweet to our beloved cat Midna and I believe she was given the best care possible, unfortunately she passed but she was treated very well.

Dr.Ou was great and very kind during everything and I felt she really cared about us and our cat Midna.

Thank you, Jose, for the fantastic rating! We’re glad to know you had a positive experience with us. Your support means a lot, and we look forward to serving you again soon! Angel Bobadilla. Hospital Director .
Everyone is friendly,helpful and knowledgeable.
The staff is very welcoming. They always see my pup on time. They handle my pup with love and care.

Got my girl (canine)in for evaluation of what turned out to be an acute subcutaneous infection. My regular veterinarian did not have office hours today and DVVH worked in and she's on her way to recovery. Saved us an emergency Vet visit.
The staff were very welcoming and handled my puppy with great care .
Thank you, Mario! We appreciate your rating and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us. Your support means a lot, and we look forward to serving you again! Angel, hospital Director.

Poor communication, sad to see this because it comes from the staff and not from the Doctors. I started bringing my dog here like 7 months ago, refilling his meds has always been an issue.
I just wasted my day and took the off from work to bring my pet in for lab work, turns out they don’t have the stuff to do it today, even though the office was the one that called me to schedule since there was an issue 2 weeks ago with running labs.
Why would you call to schedule a patient and not have what’s needed for this appointment?
Not sure if I would go back.
Thank you for your wonderful rating, Aaron! We’re glad to see you had a positive experience. Your support means a lot to us, and we look forward to serving you again soon! Angel, Hospital Director

Happy Saturday! I was sitting on the couch and noticed my fur baby's dew claw was super curvy! I tried to get it myself but he wasn't having it. I was about to make an appointment  and saw they were open 🙃. I called just by chance to see if we could come in for a trim and they had me in within less than 30 min! When I got there as always you are greeted with welcoming smiles and pleasant conversation. I walked in they took Prince and we were out of there in les time than it took to get there! I love all the ladies there! I always recommend! ♥️

Thank you, Brian, for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our community. Your satisfaction means a lot to us, and we look forward to continuing to provide excellent service.
Angel Bobadilla, hospital Director

Just want to shout out a quick review of this amazing place! Our kitty got hurt on her face,  and after a couple of days we realized it wasn't getting better. I admit we have never taken our fur baby to the "doctor" since we first adopted her through the humane society,  over 12 years ago. I was so nervous and anxious to reach out to  DVVH (Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital) in fear of judgment,  but I want to say, from the second the phone was answered,  until we left with Mimi last night,  this was 100% a positive experience! All my questions were answered about initial pricing,  over the phone! We were able to get a same day appointment,  and treatment for our girl all in ONE DAY! Upon getting to the clinic, we were greeted with the kindest most welcoming staff! Who even had snacks and drinks to enjoy while we waited to be roomed. Because our girl is not used to going out, I had so much anxiety about taking her in, but the technician was so gentle and kind about getting her vitals! They even found a room big enough for us all to go in (3 humans and Mimi)! Once the doctor came in and checked her out, we were provided a breakdown of exactly what she needed,  with no added or hidden costs! We left our girl there for her procedure,  and the staff and Dr. even stayed after hours (On a Friday too!!!) To get our girl all fixed up. I can not say enough great things about this place! The pricing, the atmosphere,  and just overall care is top notch! If you're needing a place that will treat your fur baby like their own, Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital is the place to go! Highly recommend!!!! Thank you DVVH for taking such good care of our Mimi!

*edit: I apologize I was not able to figure out how to make a new review, but did want to mention that we had another absolutely,  100%, wonderful experience here at DVVH. This was with our beloved Artie boy. A old puppers that's been with us for many years.  Special shout out to Alisha at front-desk, your kindness and empathy is something that truly made such a hard day, much easier to process. The wonderful,  kind, vet who explained every step and detail,  and really just allowed a space to say goodbye to our dear boy. The vet techs, thank you as well. Just thank you to everyone again at DVVH. Such a great place to take our fur babies.  We appreciate you all. 💜

My dog's hemangiosarcoma was diagnosed here, finally bringing closure and answering the questions my normal vet was unable to do. They also did it at record speed and didn't break my bank doing. Sadly, my Kai will not survive it and these will be her last days with us. But all of my dogs will be coming here moving forward when I transfer their charts over.

Amazing first time experience. We brought our new 8wk old puppy in to start care. The Dr listened to our concerns and assured us our puppy was okay and on the right track. Loved how the vet techs took extra care with our little puppy as she’s a micro mini and very fragile. Excited to have found a great local vet.

They were able to get us in quickly for an appointment. The Dr took her time to examine our sick puppy and explain everything. Grateful that she did not jump into just doing expensive blood work… And came up with a reasonable plan to get our puppy feeling better. I had to return same day because our puppy declined in health and the doctor quickly remedied it with medicine. So grateful they were there… Our puppy is now doing so much better.

This was the first time my pup has been sick in her 12 years, so I was pretty worried. We went to Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital as a walk-in, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. Everyone — from the receptionist to the veterinarian — was kind, attentive, and professional.

I had a few follow-up questions after the visit and needed to stop back in person the next day to confirm medication dosages. They were just as helpful and patient the second time, and made sure I felt confident about my pup’s care.

I’ve usually gone elsewhere for vaccinations and routine visits, but after this experience, Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital will be our new primary vet. Thank you for the great care and service you provide.
It was exceptionally amazing… Dexter did not feel scared or anything…. And the team made sure to make him feel safe….. 100% I would tell anyone who has a furry friend to go DVAH

I took 3 of my dogs here to get their rabies vaccination and I wasn’t told of extra charges over the phone, I only brought enough for the vaccines and I was hit with extra charges and for what? Checking their gums and heart rate? You’re going to charge $74 for that when you didn’t even tell me? So I had to pay an extra $222 and now I have another bill I didn’t even want since I had to apply for credit care and of course I was expected to pay that when it was their mistake for not mentioning anything. Not recommending this place to anyone
It was our first time here. Everyone was extremely nice. The office was super nice and inviting. Lucky was treated with care and everything was well explained.
Very good, great service

I cannot say enough good things about Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital. I brought in my 15-year-old Yorkshire Terrier when she suddenly became very ill, and they were able to get her seen almost immediately—something I will always be grateful for.

From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly kind, compassionate, and accommodating. During such a scary and emotional moment, they made me feel supported rather than rushed. The veterinarian took the time to thoroughly explain what was happening, answered my questions with patience, and was honest while still being incredibly empathetic.

She gently explained that my girl needed emergency care and provided me with several emergency hospital options, helping me make the best decision quickly. Most importantly, she offered genuine comfort and reassurance during one of the hardest moments a pet parent can face.

The level of care, professionalism, and compassion shown by everyone there truly meant the world to me. I highly recommend Dobbins Village Veterinary Hospital to anyone looking for a team that not only provides excellent medical care but also truly cares about you and your pet.
